question: What is the purpose of the NovaTech Vendor Security Questionnaire?
expected_answer: To assess third-party vendor security according to the classification of data they handle, before engagement and annually.

question: How do vendor security requirements differ for Public, Confidential, and Restricted data?
expected_answer: Public/Internal: VSQ-Lite (30 questions). Confidential: VSQ-Full (120 questions) and SOC 2 Type II audit evidence from the past 12 months. Restricted: all Confidential requirements plus an on-site or virtual security audit by the NovaTech Security Team.

question: Under what conditions can vendors receive an exception to SOC 2 Type II certification?
expected_answer: The CISO may grant a temporary exception for a maximum of six months if the vendor provides a documented remediation plan and agrees to enhanced monitoring.

question: What security precautions must employees follow when connecting to company systems remotely?
expected_answer: Employees must use the company VPN to access internal systems outside the office and must not connect company devices to untrusted public Wi-Fi without an active VPN.

question: What product features and support procedures are described in the product guide?
expected_answer: The product guide describes NovaTech ProjectHub and NovaTech Insight, including their features, pricing, technical specifications and integration capabilities. Onboarding includes self-service for all tiers, two-week Standard onboarding for Professional customers, and six-to-eight-week Premium onboarding for Enterprise. Training includes NovaTech Academy, weekly webinars and custom training. All tiers receive knowledge base, community forum and email support. Professional adds business-hours live chat. Enterprise includes 24/7 live chat and phone support, a dedicated support manager and quarterly business reviews. Professional services include data migration, custom integrations, dashboard design and process consulting.

question: How do the company's employee data protection rules and third-party vendor security requirements work together to protect Restricted data?
expected_answer: Employees protect Restricted data through strict access controls, encryption at rest and in transit, audit logging, and annual data protection training. Vendors handling Restricted data must complete VSQ-Full, provide recent SOC 2 Type II audit evidence, and undergo an additional NovaTech security audit.

question: What are the full compliance obligations of a vendor handling customer data, including assessments, certification, exceptions, and reporting changes?
expected_answer: Vendors must undergo security assessment before engagement and annually. Requirements depend on data classification. Vendors accessing customer data must have SOC 2 Type II certification, provide the latest report upon request, and report material changes within 30 days. The CISO may grant a maximum six-month exception with remediation and enhanced monitoring. Contracts accessing Confidential or Restricted data require a DPA.
